#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

spin() {
  local pid=$1 msg=$2
  local frames='|/-\\'
  local i=0
  tput civis
  while kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null; do
    printf "\r%s %s " "${frames:i++%${#frames}:1}" "$msg"
    sleep 0.1
  done
  tput cnorm
  printf "\r\033[K"
}

( {{command}} ) & pid=$!
spin "$pid" "{{label}}"
wait "$pid" && echo "done" || echo "failed"
